content.text:
The home page's three stat cards (12,400 orders, 4.8 / 5, 30 days) were partly hidden behind the hero section. I fixed it, and all 28 visual and functional tests now pass.

The cards are pulled up 56px into the hero with a negative margin. The hero is a positioned element and the cards weren't, so the hero painted over their top half.

The fix is one line, `position: relative;` on `.stats-overlap` in `site/css/pages.css`. That puts the cards back on top of the hero, as in the approved screenshots.

I didn't commit anything. `git status` also lists some untracked files I didn't create: `.idea`, `.vscode`, `site/.mcp.json`, `site/css/.claude/` and `site/css/.mcp.json`.

STATUS: DONE
